author: claude
text: Interior & Exterior Panel Signage - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install all interior and exterior building signage, including identification, wayfinding, and Code compliant signage, of every sign type detailed on the typical signage and accessibility requirements sheet, including room and door signs, electrical room signs, restroom signs, exit signs, room maximum occupancy signs, no smoking signs, and fire department connection signs, in the types, sizes, character heights, and configurations detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide panel signage consisting of flat signs with engraved panel media and tactile characters, four inches by six inches, one eighth inch total thickness, of laminated colored plastic engraved through the face to expose the core as the background color, in a flat panel black anodized aluminum frame, with tactile letters raised one thirty-second inch minimum, sans serif upper and lower case characters in a contrasting color, and Braille as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide both Type A and Type B panel sign configurations as detailed. Final sign types, quantities, and copy shall be determined during shop drawing review, and both configurations are included at no adjustment to the Subcontract Amount.

author: claude
text: Provide exterior rated sign materials, substrates, adhesives, and finishes at all signage mounted on exterior walls and in all exterior locations.

author: claude
text: Provide coated or digitally printed plastic or metal signs with Braille at all exterior electrical rooms, and signs of the same type as the room and door signs at all interior electrical rooms, as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide coated or digitally printed plastic or metal signs at all building fire department connection locations as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide the room maximum occupancy load notice, posted conspicuously by the main exit, in compliance with the International Building Code and all local requirements as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide exit signage at each door serving exit stairways, ramps, passageways, and discharges as detailed.

author: claude
text: Locate and mount all panel signs at the wall on the strike side of the door, or at the door where no adequate wall space exists, at the mounting heights detailed and in accordance with the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design and ICC A117.1.

author: claude
text: Provide all adhesives, profiles, etching, anchors, fasteners, and final adjustments.

author: claude
text: Exterior Wall Mounted Building Lettering - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install all exterior wall mounted metal building lettering at the concessions building, twenty-four inches in character height, reading TONOPAH HIGH SCHOOL and HOME OF THE MUCKERS as shown on the exterior elevations.

author: claude
text: Provide flush stud mounted installation, including all drilled holes, mounting studs, anchors, fasteners, adhesives, and sealants required for a complete exterior installation.

author: claude
text: Provide the painted finish in the color and sheen selected by the Architect from the manufacturer's full range.

author: claude
text: Provide field verification of all dimensions, full size mounting templates, and layout of all lettering prior to drilling, and provide final adjustment and alignment of all letters.

author: claude
text: Seal all fastener penetrations and perimeter joints at exterior signage weathertight in accordance with Section 07 9200, and repair or refinish all adjacent surfaces disturbed by this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Menu Display Case - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install one exterior wall mounted enclosed bulletin cabinet, five feet zero inches wide by three feet zero inches high, basis of design Aarco Products ODCC outdoor enclosed bulletin cabinet, as keynoted on the exterior elevations.

author: claude
text: Provide all bracing, mounting brackets, trim pieces, anchorage, fasteners, and all associated hardware and accessories required for a complete exterior installation, and in accordance with approved submittals.

author: claude
text: Seal the perimeter of the cabinet and all fastener penetrations weathertight in accordance with Section 07 9200.

author: claude
text: Submittals, Permits, Testing & General Scope Requirements - The following requirements shall apply to all work under this Scope of Work package:

author: claude
text: Provide Shop Drawings including dimensions, locations, elevations, materials, text and graphic layout, and attachment details, together with a sign schedule providing information sufficient to completely define each sign for fabrication, including room number, room name, all other text to be applied, sign and letter sizes, fonts, and colors. Where the room numbers to appear on signs differ from those shown on the drawings, include the drawing room number on the schedule.

author: claude
text: Where the content of signs is indicated to be determined later, request that information from the Owner through the Architect not less than two months prior to the start of fabrication, and submit a preliminary schedule upon request. Submit all sign schedules for approval by the Owner through the Architect prior to fabrication.

author: claude
text: Provide manufacturer's product data for each type of sign, indicating styles, font, foreground and background colors, locations, and overall dimensions of each sign, and provide the manufacturer's qualification statement evidencing a minimum of three years of documented experience manufacturing the products specified.

author: claude
text: Provide all deferred submittals, engineering, and sign permits required for this Scope of Work, including all fees.

author: claude
text: All materials shall comply with flame spread ratings as required; provide manufacturer's certifications.

author: claude
text: All materials and installations shall be compliant with all applicable ANSI, ADA, and IBC requirements, and with the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design and ICC A117.1. In the event of conflicting requirements, comply with the most restrictive requirement.

author: claude
text: Provide all field measurements, and coordinate the layout of all signage, building lettering, and the menu display case with the Framing Subcontractor for placement of proper backing and blocking prior to closing in of the wall assemblies.

author: claude
text: Verify that all substrate surfaces are ready to receive the work prior to commencing, and notify the Architect if conditions are not suitable for the installation of signs; do not proceed until conditions are satisfactory.

author: claude
text: Install all work in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, with horizontal edges level, secured level and plumb.

author: claude
text: Provide all tests and certifications required for complete and operational systems, and provide a qualified representative onsite for all tests and inspections as required. Subcontractor is responsible for scheduling testing and walking with inspectors to get systems signed off for final approval.

author: claude
text: Protect all work of this Scope of Work from damage until Substantial Completion, and repair or replace all damaged items.

author: claude
text: Repair all related work at completion of the Project as needed prior to acceptance.

author: claude
text: Include multiple mobilizations as may be required per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Mascot mural and painted school logo graphics, which are painted by the Owner following completion of the Project

author: claude
text: Dedication plaque and emergency evacuation map

author: claude
text: Wall backing, blocking, and structural supports for signage, which are provided by the Framing Subcontractor

author: claude
text: Painting and finishing of walls and substrates scheduled to receive signage

author: claude
text: All electrical work, including power, conduit, junction boxes, and final connections for illuminated signage

author: claude
text: Concrete footings, foundations, and all cast-in-place concrete

author: claude
text: Site signage, traffic signage, parking accessory signage, and pavement striping

author: claude
text: Track and field signage, athletic field markings, and turf inlaid lettering, numbers, and logos

author: claude
text: Scoreboards and scoreboard support structures, which are included in the Scoreboards Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Flagpoles and flags, which are included in the Flagpoles Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Marker boards and visual display units under Section 10 1100, which are included in the Visual Display Boards Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Section 10 1423 - Panel Signage - Provide all labor, material, equipment, and services required to furnish and install all items included in this section of the Project Manual, as it relates to Subcontractor's Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Section 07 9200 - Joint Sealants - Provide all labor, material, equipment, and services required to furnish and install all items included in this section of the Project Manual, as it relates to Subcontractor's Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Temporary Construction Requirements & Dust Control - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Provide a minimum 10,000 square foot construction trailer pad of fractured rock, and grade and install gravel at all Contractor parking and laydown areas as shown on the Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Construct, maintain for the duration of the Project, and remove at completion all Nye County Department of Air Quality required trackout lengths, consisting of both trackout rock and rumble plates, at all vehicular entrances as indicated on the Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Clean and maintain all trucking access routes for equipment associated with this Scope of Work, including street sweeping as required for this Scope of Work only.

author: claude
text: Supply and install a stand tank for the duration of the Project, including temporary water piping from the nearest hydrant to the stand tank and a temporary waterline to the trailer area, and remove all such temporary piping, meters, and connections at completion. Jones valve is provided by Contractor.

author: claude
text: Prepare, submit, and obtain the Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP) for the Project site, and provide installation, maintenance, and all required maintenance documentation of all controls for the duration of this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Provide dust control for all operations related to this Scope of Work in accordance with Nye County Air Quality requirements, and provide dust palliative as indicated at completion of the work at each site.

author: claude
text: Building Wrecking - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Demolish and remove from site the existing Modular Concessions Building in its entirety, including foundations.

author: claude
text: Demolish and remove from site the existing Press Box in its entirety, including deck and stairs.

author: claude
text: Remove all below-grade improvements, including foundations and utility services, within a five foot (5') boundary of the existing building footprints, and cut and cap all utilities.

author: claude
text: Include all sawcutting necessary to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Site Clearing & Selective Site Demolition - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Salvage and turn over to Contractor all items scheduled to be salvaged, including fixtures from the existing concessions building as indicated, and coordinate with Contractor for removal, protection, and storage or turnover as required.

author: claude
text: Coordinate with the Electrical Subcontractor to confirm all dry utilities are capped and made safe, and that all equipment salvage is complete, prior to commencing demolition activities.

author: claude
text: Provide all site demolition and disposal of items disconnected by others, including all abandoned conduit and feeders as indicated.

author: claude
text: Perform all wet utilities demolition, including excavation of existing underground wet utilities; remove and dispose of existing domestic water lines from the existing backflow preventer to five feet (5') outside the existing building, and existing sewer lines from the existing manhole to five feet (5') outside the existing building.

author: claude
text: Abandon in place all existing below-grade utilities not uncovered during earthwork activities, unless specifically scheduled for removal.

author: claude
text: Include all photographs and documentation of existing conditions as indicated.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing curbs, gutters, asphalt and concrete paving, including the existing running track surfacing and subsurfacing.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing fencing and gates in their entirety, including foundations and footings.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing field lighting, light poles, and the flagpole, including foundations and footings.

author: claude
text: Demolish the existing press box and bleachers, including foundations and footings as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing athletic equipment, including football goal posts and track and field equipment as indicated, including landing pit materials, and including foundations and footings as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Demolish, remove, and dispose of all existing turf materials and all existing landscaping.

author: claude
text: Provide tree removal, including stump grinding and removal, as indicated and required, and coordinate with the Landscape Subcontractor for continued irrigation of trees scheduled to remain.

author: claude
text: Clear the site of all existing organics, non-organic waste, refuse, and unsatisfactory materials, including removal of weeds at landscape planter areas within the limits of work, with haul-off and legal off-site disposal.

author: claude
text: Protect in place all items scheduled to remain, including the electrical transformer and utility vaults.

author: claude
text: Include all sawcutting required to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Domestic Water Distribution System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete domestic water system, including tie-in to the existing backflow, and all piping, fittings, valves, reducers, gate valves, bends, tees, thrust blocks, and related components and appurtenances required for a complete and functioning system at all indicated points of connection.

author: claude
text: Provide ductile iron, copper, and/or PVC water system piping, fittings, valves, and thrust blocks as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Perform multiple flush and test procedures as required by Tonopah Public Utilities, disinfect and chlorinate all water lines, and provide written documentation of all flush procedures and testing.

author: claude
text: Provide GPS as-builts of all underground domestic water, and provide a drafted plan upon completion of the utility Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Sanitary Sewer System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete sanitary sewer system, including tie-in to the existing manhole, and all piping, fittings, and related components and appurtenances required for a complete and functioning system.

author: claude
text: Include shoring as required for deep manholes.

author: claude
text: Supply and install concrete encasement of new sanitary sewer piping at water crossings where separation distances cannot be maintained, as required.

author: claude
text: Camera all sanitary sewer piping to five feet (5') outside of the building and provide video documentation to Contractor for acceptance.

author: claude
text: Provide GPS as-builts of all underground sanitary sewer utilities, and provide an AutoCAD file and drafted plan upon completion of the utility Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Storm Drain System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete storm drainage system, including all piping, catch basins, drop inlets, manholes, outfalls, and all fittings as indicated.

author: claude
text: Provide reinforced concrete pipe flared end sections at the field storm drain discharge in lieu of the cast-in-place concrete headwall detail, per Exhibit B - Basis of GMP (07.01.26) Owner Accepted Alternate.

author: claude
text: Supply and install perforated storm drainage piping at all athletic equipment sand pits, including gravel bedding and backfill as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Supply and install the perforated storm drain system along the straight sides of the turf system as indicated and detailed, including the additional perforated field drain at the south end of the field.

author: claude
text: Supply and install rip rap at the storm drain outlet as indicated.

author: claude
text: Wet Utilities Trenching, Backfill & Excavation Support - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Request Call Before You Dig on site prior to any excavation activities to obtain the dig permit, and locate and mark out all known private utilities in the vicinity of excavation activities prior to commencement.

author: claude
text: Verify sanitary sewer and water supply invert elevations as soon as this Subcontract is in place, and coordinate the layout and invert elevations of all site utility work with the Plumbing Subcontractor and all other affected Subcontractors to eliminate conflicts.

author: claude
text: Provide all excavation, trenching, shoring, and temporary protection required for this Scope of Work in compliance with OSHA standards and Contractor requirements, including all excavation support and hazard protection with shop drawings and engineering where shoring is required.

author: claude
text: Provide all work barriers, hazard barriers, hazard signage, flaggers, and traffic control for the work of this Subcontract.

author: claude
text: Perform all wet utility shading, bedding, backfill, and compaction, and ensure that subgrade elevations at completion of trenching and backfilling match adjacent subgrade elevations. All backfill operations shall be inspected by a third-party inspection agency; refer to the Geotechnical Report for backfill requirements.

author: claude
text: Supply and install all concrete for the wet utilities Scope of Work, including thrust blocks, slurry, encasement, and manhole collars as required.

author: claude
text: Provide trenching for the storm drain system as required to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Make final connection of site wet utilities to building plumbing line(s) where building plumbing is already in place, and provide all final wet utility adjustments.

author: claude
text: Earthwork - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Perform all site grading work, including over-excavation, scarification, compaction, import and export, and structural fill material to attain all on-site and off-site design subgrades, including earthwork associated with drainage features, curbs, driveways, landscaping, and site concrete.

author: claude
text: Excavate and remove all rock, caliche, and hard dig material as required based on the Geotechnical recommendations, including provision of a D-10 or equivalent dozer for hard dig as required to maintain the Project schedule.

author: claude
text: Over-excavate all areas with unacceptable soils as required by the Geotechnical Report. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.

author: claude
text: Remove and legally dispose of all abandoned underground utilities encountered during earthwork activities.

author: claude
text: Provide grading to plus or minus 0.10 foot at building and site concrete areas and at landscaping areas, including artificial turf areas, unless otherwise noted, and perform grading for all site drainage features as indicated so that all water drains as shown on the Civil drawings. Ponding will result in rework at no cost to Contractor.

author: claude
text: Coordinate backfill requirements for planting areas with the Landscaping Subcontractor, and do not use oversize material as backfill.

author: claude
text: Supply and install Type II aggregate base at the building pad and provide a certified building pad.

author: claude
text: Supply and install Type II aggregate base for all on-site curbs and asphaltic concrete paving.

author: claude
text: Provide and install rip rap as indicated.

author: claude
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment to complete backfill of all exterior building footings, and meet all drainage requirements for the site, including filter fabric and drain rock as may be required, coordinating with the Wet Utilities, Landscaping, Waterproofing, Concrete, and Masonry Subcontractors as required.

author: claude
text: Provide all import from an approved pit; on-site material shall be reviewed and approved prior to placement, and all documentation required to obtain third-party approval for the use of soil materials shall be provided.

author: claude
text: Relocate spoils to the existing stockpile location north of the High School as indicated, and legally dispose off site of all excess spoils generated by this Scope of Work at completion of the work.

author: claude
text: Provide soil stabilization at all graded slopes not scheduled to receive paving as required to maintain the angle of repose.

author: claude
text: Asphaltic Concrete Paving - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply, place, and compact all asphalt paving at the running track as indicated in the soils report and as shown on the Civil documents.

author: claude
text: Ensure the finished surface meets the Track Surfacing subsurface tolerances as specified and required, and coordinate acceptance of the finished asphalt surface with the Running Track Surfacing Subcontractor prior to their work.

author: claude
text: Provide in-house testing of the asphalt paving mix and installation.

author: claude
text: General Scope Requirements - The following requirements shall apply to all work under this Scope of Work package:

author: claude
text: Request surveying a minimum of forty-eight (48) hours in advance, in writing to Contractor, and protect and maintain all survey monuments and staking to prevent damage.

author: claude
text: Immediately cease work and coordinate with Contractor for remediation and disposal of any hazardous materials encountered during the course of the work.

author: claude
text: Provide all required testing of wet utility systems, schedule all testing, and walk with inspectors to obtain sign-off of all systems for final approval, providing a qualified representative on site for all tests and inspections as required.

author: claude
text: Provide a competent foreman who shall participate in the daily huddle and weekly workplan meetings.

author: claude
text: Include multiple mobilizations, import and export, and haul and disposal activities as may be required per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Provide record drawings as required by all Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

author: claude
text: Comply with the requirements of the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.
